stylePrefix: cute Kitchen Diary pet chef illustration, soft pastel palette, rounded line art, cozy mobile-game cooking asset, fixed three-quarter top-down camera, centered subject, clean silhouette, consistent proportions, gentle soft lighting
negativePrompt: photorealistic, text, watermark, logo, messy background, busy scene, dramatic shadows, extra limbs, duplicated tools, off-center character, cropped subject

alignmentRules.characterBaseline: paws and feet aligned to a fixed baseline near 92 percent of canvas height
alignmentRules.toolGrip: tool held in the same paw position across related frames
alignmentRules.seedFamily: reuse one seed family per pet character and one per ingredient family

templates.characterMaster: Create one cute pet chef character layer for Kitchen Diary. Keep the same animal species, face shape, hat, apron, outline thickness, paw size, and body proportions as the reference family. Transparent background. Full body visible. Paws posed naturally for holding kitchen tools. Fixed three-quarter top-down camera. Character centered and aligned to the same baseline used across the pet animation set.
templates.toolLayer: Create one isolated kitchen tool layer for Kitchen Diary. Transparent background. Centered. No hand attached. Same stylized line art and color language as the pet chef family. Keep the tool angle consistent with a three-quarter top-down cooking view.
templates.foodLayer: Create one isolated food or ingredient layer for Kitchen Diary. Transparent background. Centered single subject. Keep the silhouette clean and readable at mobile size. Match the same stylized cute cooking art direction as the pet chef family.
templates.actionKeyframe: Create one action keyframe for Kitchen Diary showing the same pet chef character with the same pose family and proportions, performing the cooking action naturally. Keep the character aligned to the same baseline and the tool aligned to the same grip position. Transparent background. No full kitchen scene. No text.
